# Search for Apple Watch Series 7 products on Amazon
import math
all_results=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=10
while True:
    page=apis.amazon.search_products(query='Apple Watch Series 7', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='+delivery_days')
    print('page_index', page_index, 'num_results', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    all_results.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total_results', len(all_results))
# Filter to Series 7 explicitly
series7=[p for p in all_results if 'series 7' in (p.get('name','') or '').lower() or 'series7' in (p.get('name','') or '').lower()]
print('series7_count', len(series7))
# Show top 5 by delivery_days then rating then price
series7_sorted=sorted(series7, key=lambda p:(p.get('delivery_days', math.inf), -p.get('rating',0), p.get('price', math.inf)))
print('top_candidates')
for p in series7_sorted[:5]:
    print(p.get('product_id'), p.get('name'), 'delivery_days', p.get('delivery_days'), 'rating', p.get('rating'), 'price', p.get('price'), 'color', p.get('color'), 'relative_size', p.get('relative_size'))
# Keep the best candidate
best=series7_sorted[0] if series7_sorted else None
print('best', best.get('product_id') if best else None)
